lines.zh: 哀绝扑向鬼杀队成员，利爪嘶鸣。
lines.en: Aizetsu lunges at the Demon Slayer, a mournful howl echoing.

lines.zh: 哀绝在阳光下蜷缩，哀鸣不已。
lines.en: Aizetsu shrinks in the sun, a mournful cry.

lines.zh: 哀绝追击猎物，尖啸声回荡。
lines.en: Aizetsu chases the prey, a shrill scream rings out.

lines.zh: 哀绝撕咬敌人，嘶鸣连连。
lines.en: Aizetsu bites the enemy, a series of howls.

lines.zh: 哀绝避开阳光，影子扭曲。
lines.en: Aizetsu avoids the sunlight, its shadow warps.

lines.zh: 哀绝靠近玩家，低沉嘶吼。
哀绝在废墟中徘徊，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Aizetsu wanders in ruins, searching for prey.

lines.zh: 哀绝躲入阴影，等待机会。
lines.en: Aizetsu hides in shadows, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 哀绝从远处窥视，低声嘶鸣。
lines.en: Aizetsu spies from afar, a low howl.

lines.zh: 哀绝突然袭来，尖啸惊心动魄。
lines.en: Aizetsu suddenly attacks, a chilling scream.

lines.zh: 我哭着穿过竹林，脚步很轻。
lines.en: Weeping, I pass through the bamboo, steps light.

lines.zh: 影子贴着地面，绕开日光。
lines.en: My shadow hugs the ground, skirting daylight.

lines.zh: 哀绝凝视远方，沉思默想。
lines.en: Aizetsu gazes into the distance, deep in thought.

lines.zh: 哀绝缓缓移动，身形飘忽。
哀绝站立不动，等待命令。
哀绝静候时机，目光如炬。
lines.en: Aizetsu waits for an opportunity, eyes like torches.

lines.zh: 哀绝静默无言，身形隐匿。
哀绝静静等候，眼神锐利。
哀绝静立不动，伺机而动。
lines.en: Aizetsu stands still, ready to act.

lines.zh: 哀绝不语，身形若隐若现。
哀绝静静观察，眼神锐利。
哀绝注视玩家，眼中闪烁。
lines.en: Aizetsu stares at the player, eyes glowing.

lines.zh: 哀绝目光锁定玩家，凝视不移。
lines.en: Aizetsu locks eyes on the player, staring unyieldingly.

lines.zh: 哀绝盯住玩家，目光如炬。
lines.en: Aizetsu fixes on the player, eyes like torches.

lines.zh: 哀绝紧盯着玩家，目光锐利。
lines.en: Aizetsu stares intently at the player, eyes sharp.

lines.zh: 哀绝目光如炬，盯紧玩家。
lines.en: Aizetsu’s eyes like torches, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 哀绝注视玩家，眼中凶光闪烁。
lines.en: Aizetsu’s eyes flash with ferocity as it stares at the player.

lines.zh: 哀绝不离玩家，目光如炬。
lines.en: Aizetsu never leaves the player’s gaze, eyes like torches.

lines.zh: 哀绝凝视玩家，目光如炬。
lines.en: Aizetsu’s eyes like torches as it stares at the player.

lines.zh: 哀绝不离玩家，眼中闪烁。
lines.en: Aizetsu never leaves the player’s gaze, eyes glowing.

lines.zh: 哀绝目光如炬，紧盯着玩家。
lines.en: Aizetsu’s eyes like torches, staring intently at the player.

lines.zh: 你身上有它喜欢的味道。

lines.en: Come closer, and you won't survive.

lines.zh: 半空中的哀绝，等待着猎物。
lines.en: Aizetsu in mid-air, waiting for prey.

lines.zh: 享受这一刻的宁静，即将结束。
lines.en: Enjoy this calm, for it ends now.

lines.zh: 你无法逃离哀绝的视线。
哀绝的眼睛在黑暗中闪烁。
lines.en: Aizetsu's eyes glow in the dark.
Aizetsu seeks its mate at night.

lines.zh: 我是哀绝，悲伤让我更强。
lines.en: I am Aizetsu — sorrow makes me stronger.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队，哀绝不会放过的！
猎物的气息，哀绝的召唤！
鬼杀队成员，哀绝的猎物！
鬼杀队的刀，我认得那声音。
lines.en: A Demon Slayer's blade. I know that sound.

lines.zh: 你身上有日轮刀的味道。
lines.en: You carry the smell of a nichirin blade.

lines.zh: 哥哥的分身，各自找了猎物。
lines.en: My brother's clones each found prey.
Weeping, I have still marked you.
I weep, but I will not stop.
My Blood Demon Art turns between my fingers.
Tears do not stop my claws.

lines.zh: 抽泣声里，我贴近你的侧面。
lines.en: Through my sobs, I close on your flank.
Sunrise is far off. You still have time to run.
Do not pity me. I do not need it.
I have locked on the crest on your uniform.
My shadow has taken your way out.

lines.zh: 哀绝狂吠，嘶吼着扑向鬼杀队！
lines.en: Aizetsu howls, lunging at the Demon Slayers!
Aizetsu swings, vicious like a demon!
Aizetsu swings, power through the wood!
My claws cross your shoulder, lightly.
I used only a little strength.
My Blood Demon Art binds your wrist.
Amid my sobs, I bite down.
Your blade slipped half an inch.
Forgive me. I must kill you.

lines.zh: 我的指甲留在你的甲上。
lines.en: My nails stay in your armor.
After that blow, I weep louder.

lines.zh: 哀绝自裂口中走出，怒视鬼杀队！
lines.en: Aizetsu steps from the crack, glaring at the Demon Slayers!

lines.zh: 哀绝自半天狗中裂出，怒视鬼杀队！
lines.en: Aizetsu emerges from the Half-dog, glaring at the Demon Slayers!
When my brother splits, I wake.
Aizetsu crawls out of the split.

lines.zh: 我落地时，先掉了一滴泪。
lines.en: When I land, a tear falls first.

lines.zh: 四个分身，我是最哀的那个。
lines.en: Four clones; I am the saddest of them.

lines.zh: 哀绝被爆炸伤：哀绝哀嚎。
哀绝被魔法伤：哀绝悲鸣。
哀绝被雷击伤：哀绝哀鸣。
哀绝坠入虚无：哀绝哀叫。
